programs.title: My Doctor's Secret Life
programs.desc: A successful psychologist remains traumatized over her passionate relationship with a former patient who sank into a deep depression and died in a car accident.

programs.title: Sinister Surgeon
programs.desc: A young doctor's dream job with a top cosmetic surgeon becomes a nightmare when she fears that he may secretly be murdering his patients.

programs.title: The Life I Can't Remember
programs.desc: Emma slowly gets her memories back from a night which put her in an amnesia-like state. She recuperates from the trauma with the help of her husband, Dr. Dean Johnson, but she remains in danger as she returns to a life she doesn't remember.

programs.title: Into the Arms of Danger
programs.desc: Two paramedics arrive at the site of a car accident to transport an injured 17-year-old girl to the hospital. But instead of taking her there, the strangers bring her to the home of a woman who's grieving over the loss of her daughter.

programs.title: Playing With Fire
programs.desc: After a near-fatal house fire, struggling married couple Natalie and Loughlin become the target of an obsessed firefighter who wants to steal Natalie for himself.

programs.title: The Paramedic Who Stalked Me
programs.desc: After a near-fatal accident, a young woman becomes the target of an obsessed EMT worker who saved her life.
